name: InterContinental Chengdu Global Center
insider_take: Sleeping inside one of the world's largest buildings, in a city famous for pandas and spicy hotpot — Chengdu's InterContinental is unlike anything else on the planet.
whats_special: The InterContinental Chengdu Global Center sits inside the New Century Global Center — a single structure so massive it could fit three Pentagons inside. The building houses an indoor artificial beach, a Mediterranean-themed waterpark, an IMAX cinema, and a skating rink, all beneath a simulated sky. Guests never have to step outside to find entertainment, dining, or retail. The hotel itself mirrors this grand ambition, with sweeping atrium views, polished IHG luxury service, and seamless access to Chengdu's booming high-tech district.
pro_tip: Book a room with an atrium-facing view for a surreal experience — looking out over an indoor ocean and artificial sunlight from your private room is a memory that simply can't be replicated anywhere else in the world.
dont_miss: Don't leave Chengdu without visiting the Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding — just 30 minutes away — ideally in the morning when the pandas are most active. Back in the city, dive into a traditional Sichuan hotpot dinner for a UNESCO-recognized culinary experience that locals take very seriously. For a cultural wind-down, stroll through the ancient Jinli Street , a beautifully preserved walkway of teahouses, street food stalls, and Sichuan folk performances.
pros: Located within world's largest building complex with integrated shopping and entertainment
Premium InterContinental luxury standards and service quality
Strategic Chengdu location with excellent connectivity
Extensive on-site facilities and dining options
cons: Large complex can feel overwhelming for some guests
